arguments.command:
cd /workspace && cat > tmp/t3.py <<'EOF'
import sys, json; sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from harness import *
fails = []
def one(events, routes=None, sid=0):
    r = run(scen(routes=routes, events=events))
    return stream_result(r, sid), r
def check(name, events, want_status, want_raw=None, sid=0, origin='rack-a', routes=None):
    rec, r = one(events, routes=routes)
    if rec['status'] != want_status:
        fails.append('%s: %r != %r' % (name, rec['status'], want_status)); return
    if want_raw is not None:
        got = raw(r, origin)[rec['offset']:rec['offset']+rec['length']]
        if got != want_raw:
            fails.append('%s raw:\n  got  %r\n  want %r' % (name, got, want_raw))
        if rec['length'] != len(want_raw):
            fails.append('%s length %r != %r' % (name, rec['length'], len(want_raw)))
        if r['origins'][origin] != want_raw.hex():
            fails.append('%s pipeline mismatch' % name)
    elif want_status != 'forwarded':
        if any(v for v in r['origins'].values()):
            fails.append('%s: pipeline not empty' % name)

def H(*extra, **kw):
    pairs = [(":method", kw.get('method','GET')), (":scheme", kw.get('scheme','https')),
             (":authority", kw.get('authority','demo.test')), (":path", kw.get('path','/'))]
    pairs += [tuple(e) for e in extra]
    return hdr(0, *pairs)

# --- prohibited fields ---
for n in ['connection','proxy-connection','keep-alive','transfer-encoding','upgrade','http2-settings','trailer']:
    check('prohib-'+n, [H((n, '')), fin(0)], 'rejected')
    check('prohib-val-'+n, [H((n, 'x')), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('prohib-in-trailer-ok?', [H(), hdr(0, ('connection','x')), fin(0)], 'rejected')
# te
check('te-ok', [H(('te','trailers')), fin(0)], 'forwarded',
      b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n')
check('te-bad', [H(('te','gzip')), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('te-empty', [H(('te','')), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('te-twice', [H(('te','trailers'),('te','trailers')), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('te-trailers-sp', [H(('te','trailers ')), fin(0)], 'rejected')

# --- content-length ---
check('cl-ok-0', [H(('content-length','0')), fin(0)], 'forwarded')
check('cl-mismatch', [H(('content-length','1')), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('cl-dup-same', [H(('content-length','3'),('content-length','03')), data(0,'414243'), fin(0)], 'forwarded',
      b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ncontent-length: 3\r\n\r\nABC')
check('cl-dup-diff', [H(('content-length','3'),('content-length','4')), data(0,'414243'), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('cl-list', [H(('content-length','3, 003')), data(0,'414243'), fin(0)], 'forwarded')
check('cl-list-tab', [H(('content-length','\t3\t,\t003 ')), data(0,'414243'), fin(0)], 'forwarded')
check('cl-list-empty-member', [H(('content-length','3,,')), data(0,'414243'), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('cl-list-bad', [H(('content-length','3, x')), data(0,'414243'), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('cl-nondigit', [H(('content-length','+3')), data(0,'414243'), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('cl-empty-line', [H(('content-length','')), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('cl-huge', [H(('content-length','0'*5000)), fin(0)], 'forwarded',
      b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n')
check('cl-huge-nonzero', [H(('content-length','9'*5000)), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('cl-with-trailer', [H(('content-length','2')), data(0,'4142'), hdr(0, ('x-audit-a','b')), fin(0)], 'forwarded',
      b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ntransfer-encoding: chunked\r\ntrailer: x-audit-a\r\n\r\n2\r\nAB\r\n0\r\nx-audit-a: b\r\n\r\n')
check('cl-missing-with-body', [H(), data(0,'4142'), fin(0)], 'forwarded',
      b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ncontent-length: 2\r\n\r\nAB')

# --- cookies ---
check('cookie-single', [H(('cookie','a=1')), fin(0)], 'forwarded',
      b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ncookie: a=1\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n')
check('cookie-join', [H(('cookie','a=1'),('x-b','1'),('cookie','b=2')), fin(0)], 'forwarded',
      b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ncookie: a=1; b=2\r\nx-b: 1\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n')
check('cookie-3', [H(('cookie','a'),('cookie','b'),('cookie','c')), fin(0)], 'forwarded',
      b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ncookie: a; b; c\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n')

# --- duplicates ---
for n in ['accept','accept-encoding','cache-control','if-match','if-none-match','pragma','vary']:
    check('rep-ok-'+n, [H((n,'1'),(n,'2')), fin(0)], 'forwarded',
      ('GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\n%s: 1\r\n%s: 2\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n' % (n,n)).encode())
for n in ['x-list-a','x-list-zzz']:
    check('xlist-'+n, [H((n,'1'),(n,'2')), fin(0)], 'forwarded',
      ('GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\n%s: 1\r\n%s: 2\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n' % (n,n)).encode())
check('xlist-bare-dup', [H(('x-list-','1'),('x-list-','2')), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('xlist-bare-once', [H(('x-list-','1')), fin(0)], 'forwarded',
      b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\nx-list-: 1\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n')
for n in ['x-a','if-range','etag','content-type','authorization','x-audit-a','user-agent','referer','accept-ranges']:
    check('dup-bad-'+n, [H((n,'1'),(n,'2')), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('dup-bad-iff', [H(('if-modified-since','1'),('if-modified-since','2')), fin(0)], 'rejected')

# --- name/value rules ---
check('name-upper', [H(('X-A','1')), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('name-empty', [H(('','1')), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('name-space', [H(('x a','1')), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('name-colon', [H(('x:a','1')), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('name-punct-ok', [H(("!#$%&'*+-.^_`|~",'1')), fin(0)], 'forwarded',
      b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\n' + b"!#$%&'*+-.^_`|~" + b': 1\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n')
check('value-cr', [H(('x-a','b\r\nc')), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('value-nul', [H(('x-a','b\x00c')), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('value-del', [H(('x-a','b\x7fc')), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('value-lead-sp', [H(('x-a',' b')), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('value-trail-sp', [H(('x-a','b ')), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('value-inner-sp', [H(('x-a','b c\td')), fin(0)], 'forwarded',
      b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\nx-a: b c\td\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n')
check('value-empty', [H(('x-a','')), fin(0)], 'forwarded',
      b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\nx-a: \r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n')
check('value-high', [H(('x-a','\u00e9\u00ff')), fin(0)], 'forwarded',
      'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\nx-a: \u00e9\u00ff\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n'.encode('latin-1'))
check('name-high', [H(('x-\u00e9','1')), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('pseudo-value-sp', [H(method='GE T'), fin(0)], 'rejected')

# --- trailers ---
check('trailer-ok', [H(), hdr(0, ('x-audit-a','1')), fin(0)], 'forwarded',
      b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ntransfer-encoding: chunked\r\ntrailer: x-audit-a\r\n\r\n0\r\nx-audit-a: 1\r\n\r\n')
check('trailer-dup-names', [H(), hdr(0, ('x-audit-a','1'),('x-audit-b','2'),('x-audit-a','3')), fin(0)], 'forwarded',
      b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ntransfer-encoding: chunked\r\ntrailer: x-audit-a, x-audit-b\r\n\r\n0\r\nx-audit-a: 1\r\nx-audit-b: 2\r\nx-audit-a: 3\r\n\r\n')
check('trailer-empty-section', [H(), hdr(0), fin(0)], 'forwarded',
      b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ntransfer-encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n0\r\n\r\n')
check('trailer-bad-name', [H(), hdr(0, ('x-other','1')), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('trailer-bare-xaudit', [H(), hdr(0, ('x-audit-','1')), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('trailer-pseudo', [H(), hdr(0, (':method','GET')), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('trailer-body-chunk', [H(), data(0,'0a0d41'), hdr(0, ('x-audit-a','1')), fin(0)], 'forwarded',
      b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ntransfer-encoding: chunked\r\ntrailer: x-audit-a\r\n\r\n3\r\n\n\rA\r\n0\r\nx-audit-a: 1\r\n\r\n')
check('trailer-size-limit', [H(), hdr(0, ('x-audit-a','y'*(8192-32-len('x-audit-a')))), fin(0)], 'forwarded')
check('trailer-size-over', [H(), hdr(0, ('x-audit-a','y'*(8192-32-len('x-audit-a')+1))), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('initial-size-limit', [H(('x-a','y'*(8192-32-3-2-2))), fin(0)], 'forwarded')
check('initial-size-over', [H(('x-a','y'*(8192-32-3-2-2+1))), fin(0)], 'rejected')
print('FAILS', len(fails))
for f in fails: print(' -', f)
EOF
python3 tmp/t3.py
